It correctly identifies Jagged2a–Notch as a ligand–receptor (DSL/EGF interface) physical pairing and Foxc1a–Pitx2 as a TF co-regulatory relationship, both biologically accurate for anterior-segment dysgenesis. (2) It omits any mention of a complex PAE (predicted aligned error) note, which is a specific expected element for judging modeled-complex confidence — this is a clear gap. The uncertainty calibration is a strength: honest, well-scoped gap_flags, low stated confidence (0.35), and no fabricated ENSDARGs or interface residues. Overall this is a solid, honest partial answer that gets the provenance framing but misses the IntAct-physical anchor and the PAE note.</justification>
